Legal classification (Phase 5.10, done properly this cycle rather than by template reflex): two axes per ע"א 4223/12. Axis 2 framing = F1: the name is a coined descriptive term with no reserved title, name_risk=[]. Axis 1 specificity = S2: Steps 4, 6 and 7 reach concrete conclusions on the user's own facts (which cap to take, PTE eligibility, whether to flip). S2 x F1 = Tier B, not A1 or A2.

The trespass mode is OUTPUT, not NAME. references/investment-term-sheets.md carried fill-in-the-blank skeletons headed SAFE AGREEMENT and CONVERTIBLE PROMISSORY NOTE with placeholders and operative clauses. Drafting a legal instrument for another person is reserved under עו"ד §20, which is disjunctive on payment, so 'it is free' is no defence. Applied remedy A2's best practice even though the tier is B: removed the instruments, kept the principles as negotiation checklists.

ייעוץ השקעות exposure is materially lower than it first looks: §3 reserves advising on the כדאיות of an investment, and this skill advises the company RAISING, not the investor deciding. Noted rather than relied on.

The disclaimer itself was advertising the trespass: the notice said 'any wording this skill drafts, whether a SAFE, a convertible note...' which asserts the skill drafts instruments. After removing the instruments the notice had to be reworded to match, otherwise the notice is the evidence.
CARRY: the live enriched `avoid` field is EMPTY ({"en":[],"he":[]}) on prod. For a regulated-domain skill the anti-trigger list is the field most worth having. Flag to Phase 9.

I OVER-CORRECTED in 1.3.1. The lead re-read the file and was right: it contained zero operative contract language (verified: no WHEREAS, hereby, shall-clauses, signature blocks or blanks), so it was deal-term parameters, not a reserved instrument. Removing the parameter tables cost five pieces of real commercial substance (SAFE conversion formula, note interest 5-8%, maturity 12-24 months, repayment on demand, security option) for no legal gain. Restored.

The correct remedy when framing is worse than substance is to fix the LABEL, not the content. 'Israeli Investment Agreement Templates Reference' and '### Key Terms Template' were the exposure; the tables under them were fine. Under ע"א 4223/12 framing is half the test, and the H1 is what a reader or scanner sees first.

Diagnostic worth reusing before deciding a file emits an instrument: grep for operative contract language (whereas|hereby|shall |in witness|signature|_____). Zero hits means parameters, not an instrument. A document-styled TITLE over a parameter table is a labelling problem.

Propagation miss confirmed by the lead's prediction: the reference rename had to reach the Bundled Resources line in BOTH languages, which still said 'agreement templates' / 'תבניות הסכמי השקעה'. Same shape as the agritech miss. Grep the resource lines and metadata.json, not just the body.
